tagline: A second look at every pull request
brief: Open-source AI code review for GitHub and GitLab, in Chrome and through MCP, with your own model key. It finds bugs in a pull request, checks each finding with a second pass, ranks them, and marks the lines that matter. It should feel calm, precise and trustworthy: a tool, not a mascot.
criteria: Success: avoids the category's magnifiers, eyes, bugs, robots and animal mascots; recognisable as a 16 px Chrome toolbar icon on light and dark toolbars; works in one colour.

concepts.name: Gutter R
concepts.idea: An R built from the editor's line gutter, with the review marker sitting in its bowl.
rationale: Ties straight to the name and reads at 16 px in the Chrome toolbar
The square marker echoes the RS badge RepoSpector places beside diff lines
One outline on a 32-unit stroke grid, 0 and 45 degree angles only

recommendation: Gutter R: the chosen direction, refined into a single outline, with a small-size cut for 16 and 32 px.
next_steps: Use the light teal variant on dark surfaces
Apply in the Chrome Web Store listing
